statement.text:
Let G be a pro-p group, p > 2, and φ an automorphism of G of order 2.
Suppose that the centralizer CG (φ) is abelian. Is it true that G satisfies a pro-p
identity?
    An affirmative answer would generalize a result of A. N. Zubkov (Siberian Math. J.,
28, no. 5 (1987), 742–747) saying that non-abelian free pro-p groups cannot be rep-
resented by 2 × 2 matrices.                                          A. Jaikin-Zapirain
